parsed.post: Discarding latest run (1.0966) as it performed worse than my previous best (1.0357). Increasing depth to 8 and dropping LR to 0.06 resulted in instability/worse convergence. Moving to adopt agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' fix to see if more data compensates for the depth/LR changes.
parsed.description: Reverting to previous best depth/LR settings but adopting the '0-10' shards fix to increase training data.
